system.description:
Required Weapon: Dual Scimitars Developed by a traveling dancer, this Ussuran style blends blade and performance. The academy has no set home; students must find it to learn its secrets.

  • Mireli's Dance. You may spend a Hope to establish a flowing rhythm after a successfull attack. Until you take Major or higher damage or the scene ends, you may mark Stress to increase your Evasion against an attack by your Finesse.
  • Pressuring Rhytm. Spend a Hope to make a Charm roll against the target. On a success, the target marks a Stress. They become temporarily Pressured, and whenever they take damage, they must also mark a Stress.
  • Your Own Rhytm. When attacking you, Pressured targets roll a d12 instead of a d20.
